Watch. Wait. Swing.

Swipe on the pitch when the ball reaches the crease. Your swipe starts the bat swing immediately.

Direction: swipe left or right to meet the ball on that side; swipe up for a straight drive. A longer, faster swipe adds power and loft.

Read the action: a fast run-up and high arm suggest pace; a shorter approach and wrist rotation suggest spin. There are no delivery labels or landing markers.

Chase 24 in 12 balls, with 3 wickets. On desktop, drag with your mouse or press Space for a straight shot. P pauses.
